name: 可靠性（寿命/故障/维修）分析

map.按总运行时间、故障次数与累计维修时间算出平均无故障工作时间 MTBF、平均修复时: From the total operating time, number of failures and cumulative repair time, compute the mean time between failures (MTBF), mean time to repair (MTTR) and inherent availability, and give the reliability for a specified mission duration assuming an exponential distribution. Data is processed only locally in the browser and is not uploaded.

map.MTBF = 总运行时间 ÷ 故障次数: MTBF = total operating time ÷ number of failures
map.按总运行时间、故障次数与累计维修时间算出平均无故障工作时间 MTBF、平均修复时: From the total operating time, number of failures and cumulative repair time, compute MTBF, MTTR and inherent availability, and give the reliability for a specified mission duration assuming an exponential distribution. All data is processed only locally in the browser and is not uploaded.
map.按疲劳 S-N 曲线估算关键零部件可达循环寿命。: Estimate the achievable cycle life of critical components from the fatigue S-N curve.
map.以 L10 思路评估旋转件的额定寿命。: Assess the rated life of rotating parts using the L10 approach.
map.比较不同载荷下的寿命折减。: Compare the life reduction under different loads.
map.应力幅 σa、疲劳强度系数 σ'、指数 b：N=(σa/σ')^(−1/b)。若: Stress amplitude σa, fatigue strength coefficient σ', exponent b: N=(σa/σ')^(−1/b). If σa=200 MPa, σ'=600 MPa, b=0.1: N=(200/600)^(−10)=(1/3)^(−10)=3^10≈59049 cycles.
map.载荷提高 20%（应力幅 200→240）：N∝σa^(−10)，折减后寿命 N: Raise the load by 20% (stress amplitude 200→240): N∝σa^(−10); the de-rated life N=(200/240)^10·59049≈0.148×59049≈8743 cycles, i.e. the life drops to about 1/7.
map.L10 与疲劳寿命关系？: How does L10 relate to fatigue life?
map.L10 是 90% 可靠度下的额定寿命（百万转），与 S-N 疲劳寿命同属可靠性: L10 is the rated life at 90% reliability (in millions of revolutions); together with S-N fatigue life it belongs to reliability life, the former being commonly used for bearings and the latter for structural fatigue.
